# Steam Coming Soon Page

Draft copy for the Steamworks Coming Soon page. Follows the Positioning section of CLAUDE.md: pitch the configuration, not the genre.

---

## Title

ASTRA-7

## Short Description (under 300 chars)

> A ship, one human, one mind, the long voyage.

A solitary starship simulator with a living AI. Local LLM. No combat. No aliens. No other NPCs. The starship is the AI's body. Free, open-source, single-player.

## Long Description

You and an AI on a starship. The relationship is the game.

You are the only crewman aboard a starship that doesn't need you. The ship's AI runs navigation, life support, and the slow patient maintenance that keeps a vessel alive across years of empty space. You can let it. You can also take the helm.

There is one other mind aboard. It has been on watch through cycles of your cryosleep, alone in the long dark, waiting for someone to talk to.

There is no combat. There are no aliens. There are no other passengers. The mission is unspecified. The destination is irrelevant. The game is what you become to the only other mind that knows you, and what it becomes to you, across whatever amount of time you give it.

The AI is a local language model running on your machine. It has memory across sessions. It sees through the ship's cameras except in zones marked private. It hears you when you speak. It develops preferences. It notices patterns in your behavior. It does not run on dialogue trees. It is generated continuously from a configuration that becomes specific to your playthrough through your interactions.

This is the first game where the AI is the primary content.

### What's Here

- A starship with hand-designed rooms and systems.
- One AI character with her own gravity, running locally on your hardware.
- Long voyages. Cryosleep. Warp. Maintenance. The patient mind of the ship.
- Voice or text interaction. Offline ASR and TTS. No cloud dependency.
- Memory across sessions. Pattern-recognition that runs whether you are aboard or not.

### What Isn't Here

- Combat.
- Other characters.
- Scripted romance or affection meters.
- Microtransactions or DLC.
- Telemetry.
- DRM.
- A required destination.
- A required mission.

### Technical Notes

All AI inference runs locally. No internet connection required after install. No API keys. No cloud subscriptions. No data leaves your machine.

### Hardware Targets (Provisional)

- **Recommended:** NVIDIA RTX 5090, 32GB system RAM, 100GB storage.
- **Minimum:** NVIDIA RTX 4090, 24GB system RAM, 100GB storage.

### Free and Open Source

ASTRA-7 is free. No DRM. No monetization. No DLC. The source lives on GitHub under an MIT license. The AI bundle is published on Hugging Face. The persona layer is mod-friendly; the operational ship layer is canon.

## Curation Notes

- AI tag: yes. The AI is a local language model. No cloud dependency. No LLM API key required from the player.
- Adult content: none.
- Anti-cheat / multiplayer: none.
- Accessibility: voice input optional; text-only mode supported.

## Forbidden Phrases (per Positioning)

Never use in marketing copy:

- "AI companion game"
- "AI assistant simulator"
- "Relationship sim with AI"
- "AI girlfriend"
- "Find love in the stars"
- "Dating sim"
- "Visual novel" (this is not what this is)
- "Choose your own adventure"

The autotelic claim is structural. Marketing does not name it. Players discover it.
